evidence.reason: The triage phase calls write_result(result) at line 799, which emits its JSON result, and drain invokes triage_phase(config) at line 831 while discarding its return value. The drain path therefore produces the triage JSON plus its own drained JSON on stdout, so callers parsing stdout as a single JSON artifact fail even on a successful drain. The fix is to keep the triage report inside the drain result and return it directly for --triage-dry-run, preserving the one-JSON stdout contract.
